day_shape: 62 items: Iran offers 7-day Hormuz reopening proposal while ruling out nuclear concessions, CENTCOM says blockade has redirected 122 vessels, US Senate rejects war-powers resolution 50-49, UK boosts Yemen aid and warns Tehran over UK soil activity.

threads.label: Hormuz proposal and nuclear standoff
threads.summary: Iranian FM Araghchi told reporters at UNGA that Tehran has offered Washington a proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz within seven days, while a senior Iranian official told Reuters Iran will make no nuclear concessions even if the US accepts. Iran International reported continuing US–Iran diplomatic contact in New York over sequencing of concessions.

threads.label: US blockade and Gulf pressure
threads.summary: CENTCOM said USS Boxer continues to enforce the US blockade of Iran, with 122 commercial vessels redirected as of 25 September, while Iran International reported Iranian threats to disrupt regional air travel as Iraqi airports curtail Iranian links. The WSJ reported Saudi Arabia and the UAE are urging Trump to maintain sanctions and the naval blockade.

threads.label: US-China messaging on Iran; Senate war-powers vote
threads.summary: US Ambassador to China David Perdue said Trump told Xi Jinping that any Chinese intelligence, components or military aid to Iran was unacceptable. The US Senate voted 50-49 to reject a Democratic-led resolution requiring congressional authorisation for further action against Iran.

threads.label: UK Yemen aid and Iran warning
threads.summary: The FCDO announced new UK funding for tens of thousands of Yemenis displaced by escalating Houthi violence, and Sky News reported Britain warned Iran it will not tolerate hostile activity on UK soil. Scottish prosecutors said they will take no action at this time against an Iranian man arrested near Britain's nuclear submarine base in March.

threads.label: Yemen: anti-Houthi mobilisation and regional response
threads.summary: Yemen's Presidential Council chairman Rashad al-Alimi called the Houthis a "terrorist militia" and urged Yemenis to join armed forces, offering amnesty to defectors, while Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan scheduled an urgent meeting on Houthi attacks. Defa Press quoted Houthi spokesman Yahya Saree claiming Saudi F-15s and Typhoons carried out 14 strikes on Yemen in 24 hours, and UNICEF reported rising child malnutrition.

threads.label: IDF Gaza operations and losses
threads.summary: The IDF said it has killed 16 key Hamas financial operatives during the war — including Jabr Moqbel of the "Moqbel" money exchange network — and eliminated two Hamas operatives involved in the October 7 attack and hostage-holding. The military also said it razed a two-kilometre tunnel in the IDF-held Gaza area, and Chief of Staff Zamir ordered a panel to probe a drone-crash "safety incident" that killed two reservists.

threads.label: Iranian military display and UNGA messaging
threads.summary: IRIB and Defa Press promoted a mobilisation of 40,000 "devoted motorcyclists" in Tehran with Tharallah deputy commander Hossein Nejat saying "no point in the country is outside our security reach," alongside Navy statements on Makran coast readiness. Regime channels reported Pezeshkian met the UN Secretary-General and Araghchi addressed ECO foreign ministers and met his Saudi counterpart, framing Iran as "victim of American and Zionist aggression."

events.summary_en: Spiritual and moral points from Ayatollah Seyyed Mojtaba Khamenei, Supreme Leader of the Revolution. Thought of death. One of the things that destroys and eliminates attachment to the world is thought of death; that is, a person can imagine for a moment that if I think I will be here for another forty years, where am I now? What is my condition? A person sees what things he can attach his heart to; for example, to a certain matter; well, that too comes to an end and goes. What remains? That is what he should attach his heart to. And sometimes a person cannot let go of his attachment, but understands this is false. The Servitude collection contains spiritual and moral points drawn from the lessons of Ayatollah Seyyed Mojtaba Hosseini Khamenei

events.title: Request for Information; Domestic and Near Shore Manufacturing of Essential Medicines on the ASPR 86 List
events.summary: The Office of Management and Budget (OMB) is conducting market research to identify new and unused (idle) domestic, U.S.-based, and near shore production capabilities for Finished Dose Forms (FDF), Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (API), and Key Starting Materials (KSM) associated with the Administration for Strategic Preparedness and Response (ASPR) 86 list of essential medicines. Responses will be shared with federal agencies that have requirements for essential medicines or responsibilities for strengthening the domestic industrial base for essential generic pharmaceuticals.
